characters.name: Washerwoman
characters.ability: Each night, the Witch shows you two players. One of them is a Townsfolk.

characters.name: Librarian
characters.ability: Each night, the Witch shows you two players. One of them is an Outsider.

characters.name: Investigator
characters.ability: Each night, the Witch shows you two players. One of them is a Minion.

characters.name: Chef
characters.ability: Each night, the Witch tells you how many pairs of adjacent players are both evil.

characters.name: Empath
characters.ability: Each night, the Witch shows you a player. The Witch tells you if that player is good or evil.

characters.name: Fortune Teller
characters.ability: Each night, the Witch shows you a player. The Witch tells you if that player is the Demon.

characters.name: Undertaker
characters.ability: Each morning, if a player was executed yesterday, the Witch shows you that player's role.

characters.name: Monk
characters.ability: Each night, the Monk protects a player from being killed.

characters.name: Ravenkeeper
characters.ability: When a player dies, the Witch shows you that player's role.

characters.name: Virgin
characters.ability: If the Virgin is nominated, the Witch tells the players if the nominator is evil.

characters.name: Slayer
characters.ability: Once during the day, the Slayer can kill a player. If that player is the Demon, the Slayer wins.

characters.name: Soldier
characters.ability: The Soldier cannot be killed by the Demon.

characters.name: Mayor
characters.ability: When the Mayor dies, the Witch tells the players the Mayor's role.

characters.name: Butler
characters.ability: At the start of the game, the Butler learns who the Mayor is.

characters.name: Drunk
characters.ability: The Drunk believes they are a specific Townsfolk role.

characters.name: Recluse
characters.ability: The Recluse appears as a Minion or Demon to ability users.

characters.name: Saint
characters.ability: If the Saint is executed, the evil team wins.

characters.name: Baron
characters.ability: The Baron adds an extra Outsider to the game.

characters.name: Poisoner
characters.ability: Each night, the Poisoner can poison a player, making their abilities unreliable.

characters.name: Spy
characters.ability: The Spy appears as a good player to ability users.

characters.name: Scarlet Woman
characters.ability: If the Scarlet Woman is executed, she becomes the Demon.

characters.name: Imp
characters.ability: Each night, the Imp can kill a player. If the Imp is killed, the Imp transfers the Demon role.

characters.name: Ogre
characters.ability: The Ogre kills a player each night.

characters.name: Amnesiac
characters.ability: The Amnesiac learns their role on the second night.
